title: Register Services as a theme (hidden): theme id, editor theme, manifest
detail: Adds 'services' to MEGA_THEMES, SiteThemeId and THEME_LOOK, 'Services' to WebsiteTheme and every Record keyed by it, the generated services.manifest.json, and the pinned counts a registry addition trips (CONTRACT_THEME_IDS and the layouts none-for-others tests: one batched phrase ask). Private like House of Fates: out of every picker. Starts after the Theme Editor lane's look-keys PR merges, because both edit lib/theme/site-style.ts. The manifest is generated from MEGA_THEMES, so it cannot land earlier (a stray manifest fails manifests.test.ts).
